verdict.rationale: The docs only imply bulk work. Kimi Code claims multi-file refactoring across an entire codebase loaded into a million-token context, and the help center lists Agent clusters ('Agent集群') and scheduled tasks, which suggest parallel or batched work. Nothing documents an explicit bulk-operation feature for acting on many items at once. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability, documentation of how many-item operations are selected and executed, limits on batch size, and independent hands-on corroboration.
